# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 3 Slot 86: 1750-1836 Eurasian Endgame Great War (oe_end_). Generated by gen_endgame_great_war.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Enact the Diplomatic Revolution (Renversement des alliances)
oe_end_dec_diplomatic_revolution = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war
		OR = {
			oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes
			oe_end_is_bloc_b = yes
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_end_dec_diplo_rev_done }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_end_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 160
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_end_dec_diplomatic_revolution.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_end_dec_diplomatic_revolution_tt
			add_gold = -160
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_dec_diplo_rev_done value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_diplomatic_revolution_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
			every_great_power = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = root }
					OR = {
						AND = { root = { oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes } oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes }
						AND = { root = { oe_end_is_bloc_b = yes } oe_end_is_bloc_b = yes }
					}
				}
				remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_archenemy target = root }
				add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_comrade target = root }
				root = {
					remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_archenemy target = prev }
					add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_comrade target = prev }
				}
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_end.2
		}
	}
}

# 2. Enforce Continental Blockade / Anti-Blockade Escort Act (10y cooldown)
oe_end_dec_continental_blockade = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war
		OR = {
			oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes
			oe_end_is_bloc_b = yes
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_end_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		has_ports = yes
		gold >= 180
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_end_blockade_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_end_dec_blockade_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:soldiers } }
	option = {
		name = oe_end_dec_continental_blockade.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_end_dec_continental_blockade_tt
			add_gold = -180
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_dec_blockade_cd value = 1 years = 10 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_continental_blockade_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
			situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
				if = {
					limit = { root = { oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes } }
					change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = 3 }
				}
				else = {
					change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = -3 }
				}
				clamp_variable = { name = oe_end_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 3. Float Century Great War Sovereign Bonds (v10.0 Economy 2.0 synergy!)
oe_end_dec_war_bonds_issue = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war
		oe_end_has_bloc = yes
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_end_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		stability >= -20
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_end_bonds_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_end_dec_bonds_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate background = estate_type:crown_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_end_dec_war_bonds_issue.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_end_dec_war_bonds_issue_tt
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_dec_bonds_cd value = 1 years = 10 }
			add_gold = { value = oe_end_gold_bonds }
			if = {
				limit = { has_advance = oe_econ2_adv_sovereign_clearing }
				add_gold = 250
			}
			else = {
				add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
			}
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_war_bonds_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# 4. Promulgate the Eurasian Charter of Balance & Frontier Guarantees (Postwar Entropy Relief!)
oe_end_dec_congress_charter = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		has_global_variable = oe_end_ended
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_end_dec_congress_done }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_end_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		at_war = no
		gold >= 200
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:burghers_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_end_dec_congress_charter.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_end_dec_congress_charter_tt
			add_gold = -200
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_dec_congress_done value = 1 }
			add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
			add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
			add_war_exhaustion = war_exhaustion_severe_bonus
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_congress_charter_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index }
				oe_ent_add_index = { amt = -12 }
			}
			every_great_power = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = root } }
				add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_congress_guarantor target = root }
			}
		}
	}
}
